metadata.name: Chapter Player
metadata.description: A cinematic video player on a violet stage: a light rides the frame edge, and chapter tabs carry a sweeping glow that doubles as each chapter's progress bar. Works with any video URL, with a built-in demo reel.
metadata.author: louisstudios
